text: A supplier registers/reads only their submissions and uploads only to the issued object key. Reject size/type violations explicitly.
criteria: Supplier B attempts access to A's key/result; deny. Over-limit file registration/upload completion never produces VALID.

text: Bind processing to a specific object version/hash; later content replacement cannot alter the meaning of an already completed result.
criteria: Upload version 1, process it, then upload different bytes to the same key; the old result still identifies version 1 and cannot masquerade as the new result.

text: Validate headers, row count, required fields, SKU uniqueness and integer price; retain line-specific errors without partial acceptance.
criteria: Run each invalid CSV variant; return the defined header/row/field error and no accepted partial catalogue.

text: Repeated object notifications or retry produce one result for the same immutable input.
criteria: Repeat notification for the same version/hash; retain one completed result and stable counts.

text: Expose status and authorized result download; distinguish invalid business content from retriable technical failure.
criteria: Fail after writing a temporary report but before status commit; retry yields one consistent published result reference.

text: A 1000-row, at-most-1-MiB nominal file reaches VALID/INVALID within 30 seconds of recorded upload completion.
criteria: Process the maximum accepted fixture and record upload-to-result timing and resource configuration.
